thread:
Cal (AE): heads-up 30min ago - RavenBridge procurement escalated. CISO says they will not move forward with the POC unless we: provide a signed mini-SLA for latency/throughput, agree to a red-team pentest window, and confirm audit-log retention + export controls. they're calling this an exec-level blocker.
Nadia (Solutions Eng): ack. which throughput do they want?
Cal (AE): they want 5k req/s sustained with p95 < 250ms for generation endpoints during the demo window. also want proof we can throttle and rate-limit by customer token.
Deepa (Security): red-team is okay but requires scope and NDA. for attestation on export controls we can provide a technical controls doc, but they specifically asked for end-to-end evidence that logs cannot be exported without their approval. we should avoid "guarantee" language.
Liam (Infra): infra note: Dedicated clusters with reserved capacity can hit 5k req/s if we configure batching + sharding. estimate 72 hours to provision a dedicated pool and validate. can speed to 48h with ops priority and weekend work. will need finance signoff for reserved nodes.
Marco (Sales Lead): customer timeline: execs want confirmation by Thu EOD or they pull the in-person demo next week. we need to escalate. propose exec bridge with their CIO + our CTO and Security lead tomorrow morning.
Tess (Legal): for a mini-SLA we can offer a scoped 30-day demo SLA but need to limit remedies and avoid open indemnities. I'll draft a short addendum. Red-team scope + NDA: I need their IP-safe scope and we must set test windows.
deploy-bot: deployment runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated-provisioning  includes checklist and costing estimator.
Nadia (Solutions Eng): I'll whip up a short perf note with sample config (sanitized) and p95 projections. sample config snippet:
```
replicas: 8
batching: adaptive
max_concurrency: 512
expected_p95: ~220ms @ 5k rps
```
Liam (Infra): ops reqs: we need a maintenance window 60m for warmup and KV-cache priming. customer must provide a short token list for traffic shaping tests.
Deepa (Security): for audit logs: we can provide append-only S3 export to their bucket with object-level immutability + KMS wrapping, plus an audit-trail PDF. will draft the controls page.
Cal (AE): action items: Cal - schedule exec bridge; Marco - loop finance & exec sponsor; Tess - draft SLA addendum + NDA checklist; Nadia - perf note + config; Liam - provisioning ETA & ops window; Deepa - controls doc + red-team process.
Marco (Sales Lead): also flag pricing: if they want reserved nodes for the POC we'll need a one-off credit + pro-rated charge. Finance needs to pre-approve quick quote.
Tess (Legal): I'll try to get a draft mini-SLA and NDA by EOD today.
Cal (AE): proposed bridge 09:30 PT tomorrow. I'll send invite once Tess confirms legal language can be shared. if anyone can't make, DM me.
Nadia (Solutions Eng): I'll have the perf note in <2h and post here.
Liam (Infra): prepping a 48h/72h plan depending on priority.
Cal (AE): thanks team  please keep updates here so I can brief the customer. :thumbsup:
